verdict.rationale: Aleph is an FP&A SaaS platform, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair capability to ask about, but the evidence pack never documents one. Scenario modeling, approval-gated agent suggestions and a free trial are adjacent features that do not isolate testing from production data. No probe found an OpenAPI or developer environment either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
